tutorial.title: A bot without code
tutorial.body: All it takes is a Discord bot token. Build what the bot does in the Actions panel.

tutorial.title: More than text
tutorial.body: Buttons, slash commands, select menus, pop-up forms, reactions and roles all work here.

tutorial.title: Never "This interaction failed"
tutorial.body: The panel acknowledges every interaction for you, so Discord never shows your users that error.

tutorial.title: Invite it anywhere
tutorial.body: See every server your bot is in, with its roles and members, and make invite links without leaving the app.
